name: DEPLOY_IN_FLIGHT
comment: ANCHOR: DEPLOY_IN_FLIGHT_20261029 — Deploy console in-flight board (DSN-20261029 + operator clarity):
GET /api/v2/ops/in-flight (scripts/lib/deploy_in_flight.py) lists open PRs to main through `gh pr list` and
projects number/title/head SHA/mergeable/mergeStateStatus/why-held/next plus plain_english, four required
checks, digest_status/can_approve (Telegram READY parity), ages, and next_plain. No write path on this
module. Hermetic: fixture PR dicts + injected lister; a gh failure is UNAVAILABLE, never 0.
